assessment: This paper presents an important investigation of the relationship between cell morphology, actin cytoskeletal features, and NF-kappaB/RELA signaling dynamics. Solid evidence is provided using quantitative live-cell imaging of pancreatic cancer cell lines. These analyses better establish the connection of cell shape to the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, highlighting the importance of the actin network and several specific regulators in a feedback loop controlling NF-kappaB activity. Because NF-κB controls inflammation and cell survival, this study will be of interest in the fields of cancer and immune signaling.
